# FVF Viewer

> Free, fast, private in-browser viewer for ScopeMeter .fvf waveform capture files.

FVF Viewer (https://fvf-viewer.com/) is an open-source, client-side engineering tool for opening, inspecting, analyzing, and exporting ScopeMeter .fvf waveform capture files directly in modern web browsers.

## Core Capabilities
- In-browser decoding: High-performance Rust WebAssembly engine decodes binary .fvf captures locally in memory.
- Multi-channel canvas: Interactive 60 FPS oscilloscope display powered by uPlot supporting simultaneous analog channels and envelope views.
- Waveform analysis: Hardware-style box zoom, pan history, and dual measurement cursors with live delta-time (Δt), frequency (1/Δt), and voltage readouts.
- Lossless data export: Export raw waveform records to lossless CSV files (comma or semicolon delimited) and high-resolution PNG snapshots (standard dark or inverted print theme).
- Built-in sample capture: One-click bundled 100,000-sample 2-channel waveform capture for instant testing without local files.

## Privacy & Security Architecture
- 100% Client-Side Execution: All file reading and WebAssembly parsing occurs in the client browser inside an isolated Web Worker via FileReader.
- Zero Server Transmission: Waveform files are never uploaded, transmitted over any network, or stored on remote servers. Works completely offline after initial page load.

## Requirements
- Desktop or tablet browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) supporting WebAssembly.
- Viewport width of at least 1024 pixels for multi-channel waveform analysis.

## Key Links & Documentation
- [Viewer](https://fvf-viewer.com/): Interactive waveform viewer application.
- [How to Open a .fvf File](https://fvf-viewer.com/open-fvf-file/): Guide on opening ScopeMeter .fvf captures in your browser.
- [Supported ScopeMeter Models](https://fvf-viewer.com/supported-scopemeter-models/): Technical reference on supported ScopeMeter families and channel configurations.
- [The .fvf File Format](https://fvf-viewer.com/fvf-file-format/): Unofficial technical overview of parser validation, record structure, timebases, and error diagnostics.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://fvf-viewer.com/faq/): Answers to common questions regarding privacy, screen sizes, exports, and errors.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/openscope-ai/fvf-viewer): Open-source codebase, issue tracker, and release tags (MIT License).
